headline: Mudryk's podcast line that Arsenal was his dream club irritates Tottenham fans; De Zerbi responds
facts: On the Guest of Gordon podcast, Mudryk called Arsenal the club he wanted to play for and said a move to the Emirates was his dream.
He is a 25-year-old Ukrainian winger on a season-long loan at Tottenham from Chelsea, and has played only 16 minutes since his deadline-day arrival because of an ankle injury.
De Zerbi said he understands fan frustration but called Mudryk a good person and told him to focus on showing his quality; he sidestepped a question about cancelling the loan in January.
background: Mudryk moved from Shakhtar Donetsk to Chelsea in January 2023 after Arsenal had also pursued him, and the same ESPN report notes he has served a drugs ban.
footage_terms: Mudryk Tottenham De Zerbi press conference
Mudryk Guest of Gordon podcast Arsenal

headline: Man Utd CEO Berrada defends Carrick sacking, club leadership and a Pochettino appointment in Sky interview
facts: Berrada said sacking Carrick after a 3-0 home loss to Bournemouth on 25 October was a very difficult decision, and admitted that some criticism of club leadership is fair.
He noted United have had three permanent managers in under three seasons and spent 163m pounds this summer, mostly on midfielders.
He said contract talks with Bruno Fernandes continue privately and that United were unhappy 16-year-old JJ Gabriel announced his exit for Real Madrid without telling them.
background: Berrada joined United as chief executive in 2024 after working at Manchester City, so he was part of the City side that is now facing the Premier League charges.
footage_terms: Man Utd Pochettino first day Carrington

headline: Drone video of Pochettino's first Man Utd training session gets millions of views, operator apologises
facts: A drone filmed about 12 minutes of Pochettino's first Carrington session on Thursday and the YouTube channel CC Overview posted it; reposts passed eight million views, according to Sky Sports.
The operator apologised on Friday, called the filming unethical though legal, and removed the video.
ESPN reports sources saying United would take legal action if a similar drone incident happens again.
background: Pochettino managed Tottenham, PSG and Chelsea before the US national team job, and his first match back in club football is at Liverpool.
footage_terms: Man Utd Carrington drone footage Pochettino training
Pochettino Manchester United first training session

headline: Iraola says Pochettino's United have a 'small advantage' and calls drone filming of training illegal-worthy
facts: Iraola said United have a small advantage because Liverpool lack reference points for how Pochettino's side will play.
United sit 18th and are eight league games without a win, while Liverpool are fourth and have struggled at Anfield.
Liverpool have not beaten United at Anfield since March 2023; Sky Sports also reports Iraola said drone flights over private training should not be legal.
background: Iraola arrived at Liverpool from Bournemouth, where he built a reputation for intense pressing football, and this is his first Liverpool meeting with United.
footage_terms: Iraola press conference Liverpool Manchester United Pochettino
Liverpool vs Manchester United Anfield highlights

headline: Arteta bans Arsenal players from picking themselves in FPL after team news leaked via a squad member's team
facts: ESPN reports Arsenal's Christos Tzolis picked and captained himself in FPL before the Liverpool game, hinting he was fit, then transferred out three team-mates a week later.
Arteta said Arsenal will take steps to stop such leaks and confirmed players will be barred from selecting themselves.
ESPN adds that Chelsea reminded staff about FPL after people linked to the club transferred out Joao Pedro shortly before a thigh injury became public.
background: Arteta has managed Arsenal since December 2019 and is known for tight control over team news before matches.
footage_terms: Arteta press conference Fantasy Premier League

headline: Bruce Arena says US Soccer 'don't have a clue' how to replace Pochettino
facts: Arena said the federation is handling the search for Pochettino's successor poorly, saying it does not have a clue what it is doing.
Pochettino left the USMNT for Manchester United after a 2-0 win over Haiti that sent the US through to the CONCACAF Nations League finals.
U23 coach Steve Cherundolo will lead a December camp and a friendly against Jamaica.
background: Arena coached the US men's team in 1998-2006 and 2016-2017, and said in 2025 that he opposed hiring Pochettino because a non-American would not grasp US culture.
footage_terms: Bruce Arena US Soccer coach search press conference

headline: Pochettino's first Man Utd interview: players must relearn the feeling of winning
facts: Pochettino said his first job is to help players regain the winning feeling, and that it needs concrete changes across the club, not just talk.
He wants players to express their talent and said pressure should create energy rather than weigh them down.
United are 18th with one league win all season, their worst start in 40 years, and he signed a contract until 2029.
background: Pochettino, 54, led Tottenham to the 2019 Champions League final and replaces Michael Carrick, who was sacked after the Bournemouth defeat.

headline: Thomas Frank jokes about the Arsenal coffee cup at his first Crystal Palace press conference
facts: Frank joked that he hopes not to be caught with similar drinkware again and said he still finds the January Arsenal cup episode amusing.
In January he was photographed with an Arsenal-branded cup before Spurs lost to Bournemouth, and said at the time drinking from a rival's cup deliberately would be absolutely stupid.
Palace are bottom of the Premier League with the worst goals-against record, and his first game is at Coventry on Saturday.
background: Frank was sacked by Tottenham in February after under eight months in charge, having previously coached Brentford.
footage_terms: Thomas Frank Arsenal coffee cup Tottenham
Thomas Frank Crystal Palace press conference

headline: Vinicius admits poor preparation after the World Cup; Mourinho says he shouldn't have said it but values honesty
facts: At a press conference in Singapore on 16 November, Vinicius said he felt overwhelmed by summer transfer talk including Arsenal's interest, and that he trained less after the World Cup; he has one LaLiga goal in eight games.
Mourinho said Vinicius shouldn't have said it, but that he does not criticise honesty, and told him to win back his place.
Vinicius lost his starting spot to new signing Yan Diomande and is available again for Celta Vigo after a four-game ban.
background: Vinicius was a Ballon d'Or favourite in 2024 but Rodri won it, and he signed a Real Madrid extension to 2032 in August after Arsenal circled.
footage_terms: Vinicius Junior press conference Singapore Brazil
Mourinho Vinicius press conference Real Madrid

headline: Amorim says 'no excuses' and questions himself after Milan lose 2-0 at home to Ferencvaros
facts: Amorim said he was not mentally prepared, the team lacked the right attitude when trailing, and Ferencvaros were better technically, tactically and mentally.
Lenny Joseph scored both goals; Ferencvaros had a player sent off late but Milan could not use the extra man.
Milan had three points from four Europa League games, 28th in the league phase, and Amorim made six changes after the Inter win.
background: Amorim is the former Manchester United manager, whose spell there ended in a sacking.

headline: Cristiano Ronaldo quits Portugal duty in a statement accusing coach Jorge Jesus of broken promises
facts: Ronaldo, 41, announced his international retirement with a men's record 146 goals in 243 caps.
He accused Jesus of breaking two promises, including having him ready for 30 minutes against Norway, and apologised to team-mates for leaving camp in September.
Farewell matches he had hoped for will not happen, and Portugal play Denmark and Wales without him.
background: Ronaldo is a five-time Ballon d'Or winner and won Euro 2016 with Portugal; ESPN lists a long history of rows with coaches from Ferguson-era Manchester United to Juventus and Mourinho's Real Madrid.
footage_terms: Ronaldo Jorge Jesus row Portugal Norway

headline: Allegri banned two games for insulting officials after Napoli's 3-3 draw with Roma, drops appeal
facts: Allegri was sent off after Balerdi's late equaliser, which he believed followed a foul on Sam Beukema.
Serie A gave him a two-match touchline ban and a 10,000 euro fine for insulting match officials and aggression toward a Roma staff member.
Napoli first said they would appeal, but a later ESPN report says Allegri decided against appealing and would watch Monza from the stands.
background: Allegri won five straight Serie A titles with Juventus from 2015 to 2019 and is known for animated touchline behaviour.

headline: Milan owner Cardinale backs Amorim with a 'Top Gun' vow: 'I'm not leaving my wingman'
facts: Speaking to Gazzetta dello Sport, Cardinale cited the Top Gun line about not leaving a wingman and said Amorim faces no threat of dismissal.
He said Amorim learned from his time at Manchester United and that the atmosphere at Milanello has improved.
Milan were fifth, seven points behind the leaders, and faced Inter in the derby that weekend.
background: RedBird's Cardinale bought Milan in 2022 and the club has changed coaches frequently in recent years, which he now says he will not repeat.
footage_terms: Amorim Milan press conference Inter derby

headline: Southgate: Kane isn't a better player than two years ago, just more confident, after Ballon d'Or win
facts: Southgate told ITV that Kane has not become a better player in two years, but his biggest change is self-belief.
Kane won the Ballon d'Or last month, beating Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal and becoming the first English winner in 25 years.
Southgate recalled telling Kane after the 2024 final defeat that he would win the league with Bayern, which then happened.
background: Kane lost the 2021 and 2024 European Championship finals with England under Southgate and left Tottenham for Bayern in 2023 without a major trophy.
footage_terms: Southgate Kane Ballon d'Or ITV interview

headline: Kompany returns to the Bayern bench after collapse at training, says he is in good health
facts: Kompany collapsed at a reserve-team training session on 23 October and was treated for meningeal irritation; he returns for the Cologne game on 20 November.
He missed five games, in which assistant Aaron Danks led Bayern to five unbeaten, including a 2-0 win over Atletico Madrid.
He said all test results are clear and that he rethought how he listens to his body after returning for the Arsenal game while fighting a viral infection.
background: Kompany, a former Manchester City captain, took charge of Bayern in 2024 after managing Burnley, and Bayern now lead the Bundesliga level with Dortmund.

headline: Luis Enrique says Vitinha deserved a higher Ballon d'Or rank than 14th
facts: Luis Enrique said Vitinha was not ranked as high as he deserves, praising his technical and physical ability.
Vitinha finished 14th, a year after placing third when team-mate Dembele won.
PSG were named Men's Club of the Year at the 70th Ballon d'Or ceremony, with Kvaratskhelia sixth and Dembele seventh among PSG players.
background: PSG won the 2025 Champions League under Luis Enrique and Dembele took the 2025 Ballon d'Or, making Vitinha's drop from third to 14th notable.
footage_terms: Luis Enrique Vitinha Ballon d'Or press conference

headline: Haaland tells Man City to 'step up' even after his late winner at Leipzig
facts: Haaland scored the 78th-minute winner in City's 3-2 Champions League win at Leipzig, his 14th goal of the season and 13th against Leipzig.
He said City should have been more aggressive after going ahead and made better decisions about when to keep the ball.
The win followed a Premier League loss to Brighton, City's second straight league defeat.
background: Haaland joined City from Dortmund in 2022 and has scored heavily in the Champions League against German clubs.
footage_terms: Haaland winner RB Leipzig Manchester City highlights

headline: Fabregas warns Como not to believe the hype after a record 9-1 Champions League win at Lens
facts: Como won 9-1 away at Lens, tying Bayern's record for goals in a Champions League game.
The eight-goal margin tied the competition record and nine is the most goals scored on the road in the competition's history.
Fabregas told his players not to believe their own hype and to enjoy the day, then keep performing; Como moved up to fourth.
background: Fabregas won the 2010 World Cup with Spain and played for Arsenal, Barcelona and Chelsea before moving into coaching at Como.

headline: Pulisic calls new Milan contract 'the most important chapter' of his career
facts: Pulisic, 28, re-signed with Milan through 2031 and said he is in love with the club and that his family is happy there.
His previous deal ran to June 2027, and the new one extends beyond the next World Cup.
The renewal came a day after Milan announced a new stadium due to open in 2031.
background: Pulisic joined Milan from Chelsea in 2023 for a reported 22m euros and has 44 goals and 28 assists in 141 appearances for the club.

headline: Hoeness says Musiala may never return to his old level; Bayern board backs him
facts: Hoeness called the situation a dilemma on BR, said Musiala's illness can be managed with medication but not easily cured, and doubted he would return to his former level.
Sport Bild reports the supervisory board backed Hoeness at its Monday meeting; CEO Dreesen said he hopes Musiala returns.
Kompany said he believes Musiala will return and succeed, and Musiala is expected back against Cologne on Friday.
background: Musiala has had repeated setbacks since a serious injury at the 2025 Club World Cup, and Goal reports a neurological condition causing treatable brief absence seizures.

headline: Zidane says France are not seeking revenge on Spain in Nations League quarter-final
facts: France coach Zidane said the Nations League quarter-final against Spain is not a chance for revenge for the 2026 World Cup semi-final loss.
He called it a different competition and a new group, aiming for the semi-finals and the title.
The first leg is on 25 March 2027, the return in France on 28 March, and the final on 13 June.
background: Zidane won the 1998 World Cup and Ballon d'Or as a player and three Champions Leagues in a row as Real Madrid coach.
footage_terms: Zidane press conference France Spain draw
France Spain World Cup semi-final highlights 2026

headline: Thomas Muller says MLS play is 'careless' because there is no relegation
facts: Muller told Global News that without promotion and relegation players feel less pressure, so MLS teams can be careless defensively.
He described a laissez-faire approach that produces attacking highlights but less consistency, with players struggling to stay focused for 90 minutes.
He contrasted this with Europe, where relegation threatens budgets, staff and fans.
background: Muller left Bayern Munich after a long career there and joined the Vancouver Whitecaps in 2025.
footage_terms: Thomas Muller Vancouver Whitecaps interview MLS

headline: Gerrard backs Iraola at Liverpool and says keeping Gakpo was essential
facts: On Goal's Beast Mode On Podcast, Gerrard said Iraola earned the Liverpool job and needs patience to shape a title challenger.
He said keeping Gakpo was essential and praised the forward's World Cup, pre-season and start to the season.
Manchester City and Tottenham had both been interested in Gakpo in the summer.
background: Gerrard is a Liverpool legend who later managed Rangers and Aston Villa.
footage_terms: Steven Gerrard Beast Mode On podcast Liverpool

headline: Haaland 'incredibly happy' at City and avoids talk of sanctions after scoring for Norway
facts: After Norway beat Wales 3-1, Haaland scored his 66th international goal in 60 caps and said he is incredibly happy at City.
He declined to discuss the legal dispute in detail, said his contract stands, and noted the period under investigation, 2009 to 2018, was before he joined.
City were found guilty of more than 100 breaches of Premier League financial rules, have appealed and deny wrongdoing.
background: Haaland signed for City in 2022 and extended his deal in late 2024.

headline: De la Fuente slams 'lying' over claims Yamal gets special privileges from Spain
facts: De la Fuente defended Yamal, who had right-knee inflammation and joined camp late after Barcelona's 2-1 win at Atletico Madrid.
He said medical staff recommended rest at home, denied special treatment, and said he was upset by what he called lying and fabrication in reports.
He expected Yamal to be available by Friday; Spain lead their Nations League group and are already in the quarter-finals.
background: Yamal was one of the two players, with Mbappe, who Kane beat to this year's Ballon d'Or, according to ESPN's Southgate report.
footage_terms: De la Fuente press conference Yamal privileges

headline: Iraola goes viral after posing with kids at a grassroots match near Liverpool
facts: Iraola watched a junior Maghull FC game during the international break, reportedly to see a relative, and posed for photos with children.
A photo with two young players posted by Maghull FC passed a million views.
Maghull manager Joe Burns said Iraola spent a long time with the kids, and fans called him down-to-earth.
background: Earlier this year, while still Bournemouth manager, Iraola was seen working as an assistant referee at a local match.

headline: Mourinho says he'd be 'grateful' if Ancelotti gives Endrick minutes for Brazil
facts: After a 3-0 win at Valencia, Mourinho said he would be grateful if Brazil coach Ancelotti gives Endrick plenty of minutes.
Endrick has played 141 minutes for Madrid this season with one start and one goal, and said he is unsure about his future beyond January.
Mourinho has said Endrick's future is at the Bernabeu.
background: Mourinho returned to Real Madrid as coach, a club he previously managed from 2010 to 2013, where he clashed with Ronaldo; Ancelotti, whom he now quotes, coached Madrid before taking Brazil.
footage_terms: Mourinho press conference Endrick Brazil Ancelotti

headline: Kane thanks acupuncture doctor who revived his career before breaking England's caps record
facts: Kane credited acupuncture specialist Dr Alejandro Elorriaga Claraco, whom he began working with in 2020 after a run of injuries, for reviving his career.
At 33 he shared England's all-time caps record with Peter Shilton and was due to take sole ownership with his 126th cap against Croatia at Wembley.
ESPN reports he broke the record in that match and was inspired by Luka Modric as he chases his biggest dream.
background: Kane is the reigning Ballon d'Or winner, and England's all-time top scorer, having moved to Bayern from Tottenham in 2023.
footage_terms: Kane 126th cap England record Croatia Wembley
